doc: upowerd provides the org.freedesktop.UPower service on the system message bus. Users or administrators should never need to start this daemon as it will be automatically started by dbus-daemon(1) whenever an application calls into the org.freedesktop.UPower service.
Written by David Zeuthen <davidz@redhat.com> with a lot of help from many others.
Please send bug reports to either the distribution or the DeviceKit mailing list, see http://lists.freedesktop.org/mailman/listinfo/devkit-devel on how to subscribe.
